QuestInfo.name: The New Song
QuestInfo.0: He must have found his Composition Notes by now. Go and get the Composition Notes from #bMaestro Rho#k.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver the #bComposition Notes#k to #bLana#k, the CEO of Big Hit Records.
QuestInfo.2: All preparations for Blake's debut performance are now complete. Go over to #bBlake#k and give him the good news.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,600\nCan proceed to the Debut Preparations Complete quest\n

0.0: Dum dum de dum... Oh, you're back. I'll give you my new song as promised.

yes.0: Here you go, my precious Composition Notes. Please tell #bLana#k at Big Hit Records to make sure Blake performs my new song at his debut concert.

no.0: Are you declining my new song? Unbelievable!

1.0: What took you so long? Here, give me the new song.

yes.0: So we have a song... What are we missing?

npc.0: Please deliver my Composition Notes to #bLana#k, the CEO of Big Hit Records.

item.0: Where did the Composition Notes go?

lost.0: How dare you drop my Composition Notes! Do you know what could have happened if I hadn't picked it up? Ugh, I don't even want to think about it. I'll give it to you again. Make sure you deliver it to #bLana#k, huh? Geez.
